artifacts.summary: Ported the LC_n limit-closure soundness content into FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/ as PlusOmegaChain.lean and PlusLCSchema.lean, with lcN_plusValidZTime landed at the .ZTime frame class and .Base recorded as open and unclaimed.

completion_data.completion_summary: Landed Reynolds' infinite limit-closure schema LC_n and its validity at the .ZTime frame class in two new FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/ modules: PlusOmegaChain.lean (the omega-limit-of-splices principle and the omega-chain it drives, under an explicit cofinality hypothesis on the markers, plus intOrder_omega_cofinal as its only available discharge) and PlusLCSchema.lean (gle, bigAnd, lcAnte, lcCons, lcN, lcN_plusValidInt, lcN_plusValidZTime). Twelve new public theorems are axiom-pinned in C14 from measured profiles and carry docs/theorem-index.md rows stating the conditional form honestly; .Base validity of LC_n is recorded as open and is claimed nowhere. The 814-line source probe was promoted into tracked specs/evidence/ and wired into the evidence-probe gate so that archiving its originating task is harmless.
